data.title: Bitcoin Beats Almost Every Major Asset Over 10 Years, Now Visser Calls It An ‘Anti-Decay’ Hedge
data.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in over $1.9 billion this week, while 10-year return data from a Creative Market Strategist showed Bitcoin up 13,200%, trailing only Nvidia.
data.keywords: traditional growth, Jordi Visser, Bitcoin, Visser
